title: ✨ 5 things to do in Cusco on your first day (perfect for acclimating)...
description: ✨ 5 things to do in Cusco on your first day (perfect for acclimating) 🇵🇪 Just landed in Cusco and not sure what to do on Day 1? 👀 Don’t worry, it’s not all about sleeping 😴… you can also start exploring without pushing your body too hard, helping you adjust to the altitude little by little. Save this video because here are 5 must-do plans in Cusco for when you arrive 👇 1. Take the classic Cusco City Tour Start slow by visiting incredible spots like Qoricancha, Saqsayhuamán, Qenqo, Tambomachay, and Puka Pukara. 2. Snap a photo at 7 Borreguitos Street 3. Wander through the San Blas neighborhood 4. Stroll around the Cusco Plaza de Armas 5. Head up to the Cristo Blanco viewpoint 💡 All of these plans are super chill and help you acclimate to the city while avoiding altitude sickness. 👇 Now tell me… Which one would you do first? 👀 #travel #tour #cusco #perutravel #traveltips What to do in Cusco on your first day | Cusco altitude tips | Cusco 2026 itinerary | Acclimatizing in Peru | Cusco City Tour | Instagrammable spots in Cusco | Best time to visit Cusco
